rooms.name: Berserker Cairns
rooms.desc: Two rings of dirt track circle the hillside, each edged with ten-foot heaps of slick black stones.
rooms.dm: Burial cairns of an old berserker tribe, untouched for centuries.

rooms.name: Berserker Cairns
rooms.desc: Black stone cairns line both tracks along the eastern slope.
rooms.dm: The path from Y1 crosses both rings here on its way up to the boulder ring.

rooms.name: Berserker Cairns
rooms.desc: Black stone cairns line both tracks along the south-eastern slope.
rooms.dm: Mouldering berserker bones under every cairn.

rooms.name: Berserker Cairns
rooms.desc: Black stone cairns line both tracks along the southern slope.
rooms.dm: Mouldering berserker bones under every cairn.

rooms.name: Berserker Cairns
rooms.desc: Black stone cairns line both tracks along the south-western slope.
rooms.dm: Kavan's cairn is here (Blood Spear of Kavan).

rooms.name: Berserker Cairns
rooms.desc: Black stone cairns line both tracks on the north-western slope, the fog close beyond.
rooms.dm: From this slope the vision in the fog (Y5) is plain to see.

rooms.name: Trail
rooms.desc: A path winds up through dense forest toward a bare hill heaped with black stone cairns; storm clouds pile overhead and lightning lances the top.
rooms.dm: The path forks into the two rings of Y2 and climbs on to the summit.

rooms.name: Druids' Circle
rooms.desc: A broad circle of black boulders round a patch of withered turf, and inside it a fanged, cloaked giant of woven sticks and black soil fifty feet tall.
rooms.dm: The ring is 250 ft across and 5-10 ft high. Details and creatures are on the Summit level.

rooms.name: Gulthias Tree
rooms.desc: A sickly thicket of dead trees and brush on the summit's southern side, a monstrous twisted tree in its midst.
rooms.dm: The Gulthias tree and its blights (Summit level).

rooms.name: Wall of Fog
rooms.desc: Westward everything simply ends: a wall of fog rises out of sight.
rooms.dm: Marks the boundary of Strahd's domain; the old mountain folk called it the Whispering Wall.

objects.desc: A fifty-foot effigy of woven sticks stuffed with black soil: a giant fanged figure in a cloak, roots coiled round its feet.
An enormous gnarled tree oozing dark red sap, an axe bright in its trunk and a skeleton among its roots.

objects.label: Kavan's cairn: under the heavy rocks lie his moldy bones and the blood spear (appendix C); the chosen character gets +2 to hit and damage with it (Blood Spear of Kavan event).
Up through dense forest to a bare hill of black cairns under massing storm clouds, lightning on the top; westward the world ends in fog.
Two dirt tracks circle the slope, each edged with ten-foot cairns of slick black stone: graves of an old berserker tribe, untouched for centuries.
The battle is on the Summit level (the inset): graves, druids, berserkers; lightning strikes the ring.
The copse of the Gulthias tree; its blights are placed on the Summit level.
Looking west from the summit or the west slope: a pale castle above a far-off city seems to float in the fog, and a bell tolls faintly. It is an illusion. Entering the fog: Mists of Ravenloft (ch.2).
Contour +400 ft: the hill climbs about 400 ft from the forest to the top (the map is drawn flat).
Contour +300 ft: the hill climbs about 400 ft from the forest to the top (the map is drawn flat).
Contour +200 ft: the hill climbs about 400 ft from the forest to the top (the map is drawn flat).
Contour +100 ft: the hill climbs about 400 ft from the forest to the top (the map is drawn flat).

Druids' Ritual: when Strahd comes (on Beucephalus or as a bat) the druids rise and chant for 10 rounds; Wintersplinter, a tree blight, bursts from the statue and marches north on the Wizard of Wines. Needs room for a Huge creature.
The party comes up the trail from the north-east

rooms.name: Druids' Circle
rooms.desc: Withered turf inside a circle of black boulders five to ten feet tall, broken by two paths; the stick-and-soil effigy of a fanged, cloaked man looms over it.
rooms.dm: Twelve hidden turf-covered graves (six druids, six berserkers). The gem is in the statue's chest. Lightning may strike anyone who climbs the ring.

rooms.name: Gulthias Tree
rooms.desc: Dead trees and brush round an enormous gnarled tree oozing dark sap; spiny, gangly shapes prowl about it; an axe shines in the trunk above a skeleton.
rooms.dm: Gulthias tree; 6 needle blights in plain view, 3 vine and 12 twig blights hiding.

Six druids and six berserkers sleep under sod covers; they rise if anyone approaches or harms the statue, or once found and attacked. Replenished at dusk (1d4-1 of each a day, up to six).
